For the first time in years, he went downstairs and unlocked the door.","w02":"凌晨四点，城市像一本尚未合上的书。路灯照着空荡的街道，雨水在井盖旁积成碎银。早餐铺亮起第一盏灯，蒸汽轻轻推开玻璃上的寒意。清洁工拖着长长的影子走过，远处一辆货车低声驶向市场。楼上偶有窗户亮着，不知是谁刚刚归来，又是谁整夜未眠。天边渐白，鸟鸣还没有醒。","w03":"- Recursion means solving a problem by using the same method on a smaller version of it.\n- Imagine opening a box, finding a smaller box inside, and repeating until you reach a toy.\n- A recursive instruction needs a stopping rule, like stopping when there are no more boxes."}
